The U.S. Open last year began paying professionals $10,000 if they missed the cut.Editor's Picks2025 Masters: Complete coverage of McIlroy's first green jacketESPN StaffScottie Scheffler won $3.6 million last year.Prize money at the four majors has been increasing in small amounts over the past several years. Ten years ago, Jordan Spieth earned $1.8 million for his Masters victory when the total prize fund was $10 million.The Players Championship remains the richest tournament with a $25 million purse, with $4.5 million won by Rory McIlroy last month. The PGA Tour goes to the RBC Heritage in South Carolina next week with a $20 million purse ($3.6 million for the winner) as a signature event.
